scope.changed: Python worker, isolated regression tests and routing contract/evidence

boundary: Public Store/tick to actual run_native, OS file_lock on temporary auth directories, controlled tests/fake_native.py subprocess through the external command adapter. No mocked busy outcomes or real provider calls in new regressions.

observations: All busy: only profile a visited; profile b never considered.
Pinned busy a: tick returns False before later independent Claude job.
Unpinned busy a: tick returns False instead of executing free codex b.
red.reproduce: Run committed regressions at 3ae350f, where worker still equals baseline.

ranked_predictions: Early busy return prevents scanning later jobs.
Without excluding busy candidates, selection chooses the same profile again.
Updating last_used before lock acquisition counts nonexecution as usage.
diagnosis.confirmed: Busy must be a bounded candidate skip, not a terminal tick result. Busy attempts leave inference count and usage unchanged.

fix.busy_state: Per-tick set, cleared for next tick; a busy candidate is tried at most once per tick.
fix.unpinned: Re-evaluate remaining eligible same-provider candidates in existing priority order.
fix.pinned: Wait for pinned candidate; independent later jobs may execute.
fix.idle: When no candidate can execute, return False without spinning; retry on a later tick.
fix.inference_attempts: Busy acquisition rolls back claim increment; successful real invocation counts one attempt.
fix.safety: Busy does not change quotas, holds or last_used. Native locks are never forcibly released and holders are never stopped. Real quota/error/uncertain/edit-review paths retain prior behavior.

scenarios: Pinned busy Codex a allows a later independent Claude job.
Unpinned busy Codex a yields to eligible Codex b in the same tick; total inference attempts one.
Both Codex profiles busy: each visited once per tick, three bounded idle ticks, zero attempts; release resumes preferred a with one execution.
Pinned a never uses free b; release runs a.

spec.notes: Provider/pin/quota/hold/model priority and edit-review behavior preserved; busy alone permits same-tick retry.

evidence_followup.verified: All four log hashes/tails match; red commit retains baseline worker unchanged; contract evidence pointer resolves.
